rawCommits.subject: fix(dev-loop): reattach harness loops that survive a server restart
rawCommits.body:
The harness sidecar outlives aura-os-server restarts, but the automaton
registry, loop registry, and event forwarder are all in-memory -- so a
restart left the loop running headless: tasks kept advancing while
/loop/status reported idle and no WS events reached the UI.

Persist a small run-handle file per Automation run; on a status query
with an empty registry, probe the harness and report
loop_state="detached" so the AutomationBar re-adopts the run via the
existing POST /loop/start conflict path (rebuilding the forwarder and
re-emitting loop_opened). Stop now also sweeps detached handles so it
reaches harness runs this process never registered, and adoption skips
the orphan-task sweep so it cannot flip a live run's in_progress tasks
back to ready.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

rawCommits.subject: fix(chat): render compaction tool markers as blocks
rawCommits.body:
Cold-start history rebuild renders persisted tool activity into flat
assistant text using the `[tool_use NAME input=...]` / `[tool_result ...]`
/ `[tool_error ...]` dialect (compaction.rs). The chat marker expander
only recognized the `[tool: name(arg) -> ok]` dialect, so these fell
through to SegmentedContent as literal text (e.g. a raw list_tasks
result instead of a structured block).

Teach tool-markers.ts to recognize the compaction dialect, hoisting each
tool_use (with parsed JSON input) and pairing it with the following
tool_result/tool_error into a single ToolCallEntry that routes through
the shared Block registry (list_tasks -> ListBlock, etc.). Body parsing
is token-anchored to tolerate ]/newlines/truncation in result JSON, and
streaming tails are trimmed until complete.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

rawCommits.body:

XML, or the hybrid `[tool_use name="..."> </invoke>` shape) inside a text
content block instead of as a native tool_use event, so it streamed through to
the UI as raw text.

Client: tool-markers.ts now detects well-formed <invoke> blocks (and the
hybrid opener) and hoists them into tool cards, relaxes the compaction parser
so a `[tool_use name ...]` without input=JSON still renders, scrubs any
leftover XML/hybrid residue from text segments, and hides in-flight XML tails
while streaming.

Server: a dependency-free scrubber strips leaked markup from assistant text
and the persisted text content blocks before they are stored (and re-fed on
cold-start compaction), and logs a warn when it fires for upstream visibility.

The true root-cause fix (text-vs-tool routing) lives upstream in the harness
provider stream parsing and is left as a follow-up.

rawCommits.subject: perf(chat): refactor input bar auto-resize and multi-line layout
rawCommits.body:
Typing in the main LLM input was laggy: every keystroke re-rendered the
entire chat surface (the draft subscription lived in useChatPanelState),
and the shell's autoResize ran up to three forced reflows per character
with anti-oscillation padding simulations and a ResizeObserver lockout.

- Localize draft re-renders: ChatSurface binds the draft via a leaf
  DraftedInputBar wrapper; useChatPanelState writes drafts imperatively,
  so keystrokes re-render only the input bar.
- Replace the resize machinery with useInputAutosize: hidden mirror
  elements measure wrap state against the fixed single-line layout, so
  the decision is deterministic (oscillation impossible by construction)
  and each value change costs a single write-read-write layout pass.
- Multi-line layout: the textarea spans the full container width with
  equal side insets; attach, model picker, and the send/stop button move
  into a real flex bottom row, replacing the absolute re-anchoring CSS.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

--localstorage-file, is a method-less stub; under Vitest's jsdom
environment it shadowed jsdom's localStorage and broke ~45 suites with
'localStorage.getItem is not a function'. Pass
--no-experimental-webstorage to the test workers and add an in-memory
Storage fallback in src/test/setup.ts.

Also updates tests that had drifted behind committed product changes:
ListItem treeitem row contract (TaskOutputPanel, Sidekick), lazy
run/terminal panes, Chats tab rename, paginated per-session history,
3D-generation model arg, orbit-repo project form, structured terminal
API errors, log-event content envelopes, redesigned billing/profile
panels, and marketing/public-chat copy.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

rawCommits.subject: fix(chat): hoist unterminated tool_result markers instead of leaking prose
rawCommits.body:
A read_file dump emitted as an unterminated [tool_result ...] compaction
marker (multi-line N| content with no closing bracket) was skipped by the
marker parser and leaked verbatim into markdown, rendering as an unreadable
mashed wall of text. Once a turn is finalized, hoist such markers into a
collapsible tool card, bounding the body to the run of N|-numbered lines so
the model's trailing prose stays a separate text segment. Streaming behavior
is unchanged: incomplete markers stay as text and remain hidden by the
stream-safe tail trimmer until they close.

rendered.title: Smoother chat streaming, leaner input bar, and a rebuilt observability pipeline
rendered.intro: A heavy nightly across the board: the chat surface gets virtualization, paginated history, and a frame-batched streaming pipeline that stops chat and the terminal from starving each other. The 1,500-line ChatInputBar is broken apart, typing lag is eliminated, and dev loops gain reattach-after-restart resilience. On the platform side, per-tool permissions become first-class, swarm VM logs surface in agent details, and the observability/status pipeline is rebuilt around a single snapshot source.

entries.title: Streaming pipeline rewrite and chat transcript polish
entries.summary: A late-night sweep tightened the chat transcript's visual details and rebuilt the streaming hot path so chat and terminal stop fighting for the main thread.

items.text: Rebuilt chat and terminal streaming around a single rAF loop: chat reveals coalesce into one store update per frame with markdown rendered as memoized per-paragraph blocks, while PTY output now ships as coalesced binary WebSocket frames and flushes to xterm once per frame — ending the per-token setState storm that was starving the terminal.

Fixed several streaming-order and formatting bugs in the transcript: the timeline now reveals strictly in order behind a still-typing paragraph, block collapse animates symmetrically with expand, expanding a block scrolls its body into view, and user messages preserve newlines and runs of spaces instead of collapsing them.

Cleaned up command and list rendering: command rows recover their input from alternate keys instead of showing a bare "$ ...", list summaries follow titles directly, block copy buttons only appear on hover/focus, and the gradient band behind the streaming indicator was replaced with a shrink-wrapped pill.

Sidebar projects gained live open/closed folder icons in both the zui Explorer and the desktop LeftMenuTree, with collapsibles flipped to left-aligned labels and far-right chevrons across sidekick, explorer, message queue, and marketing surfaces.
Terminal links now open in the OS default browser instead of triggering Windows' "about:blank" app picker, with the Rust new-window handlers restricted to http/https/mailto.

Observability and dev-loop plumbing: status health checks were made complete, the CI artifact poller now retries fetch failures, and the start_dev_loop MCP tool threads the calling agent's model so harness loops stop hitting "missing model" 400s.

entries.title: Dev-loop model resolution from the calling agent
entries.summary: A follow-up closed the remaining gap where agent-driven loop starts still hit the harness without a model.

items.text: When start_dev_loop is invoked without an explicit model arg or AURA_MCP_MODEL, the MCP tool now looks up the calling project-agent instance and uses its default_model, so live agent-driven loops no longer fail the harness "missing model" check.

entries.title: Default desktop service URLs in CI workflows
entries.summary: Release Infrastructure: aligned desktop service URL defaults across performance, validate, and release workflows.

items.text: Standardized default desktop service URLs across the performance-benchmark, desktop-validate, and nightly/stable release workflows so CI jobs no longer disagree on which environment they target.

entries.title: Inline thinking prose, swarm VM logs, and resilient dev-loop tasks
entries.summary: Three substantial features landed back-to-back: reasoning becomes fully readable, swarm VMs expose their logs in the UI, and dev-loop runs keep the task UI live through event-stream resyncs.

items.text: Thinking segments now render as full dimmed inline prose in the activity timeline instead of hiding behind a collapsed "Thought for Xs" chevron, flowing chronologically between tool rows across live streams, finalized turns, and history.
Agent details gained a VM Logs tab that proxies live tail and termination snapshots from the swarm gateway, exposing per-VM log streams directly in the UI via a new RemoteLogsPanel.

Dev-loop runs no longer freeze task statuses when the firehose forces a resync: the forwarder coalesces text_delta events (~100ms / 4KB / 250ms-age caps), the client refetches tasks on a bumped resyncNonce, and the post-start_dev_loop startLoop bridge now retries instead of silently leaving the loop forwarderless.

entries.title: Swarm integration guide, env reference, and ops runbook
entries.summary: Docs: a full aura-swarm onboarding and operations bundle landed.

items.text: Added an aura-swarm integration guide, environment-variable reference in .env.example, and a swarm-operations runbook covering day-to-day operations, surfaced from the docs README.

entries.title: Virtualized transcript, decomposed input bar, and platform-wide upgrades
entries.summary: The day's biggest batch reshapes the chat surface end-to-end, persists per-tool permissions, hardens dev loops against server restarts, and consolidates the observability pipeline.

items.text: Chat history is now cursor-paginated end to end: new server routes serve windowed events with stable reconstructed ids, ChatMessageList is virtualized via @tanstack/react-virtual with pin-to-bottom and prepend preservation, and per-token re-renders are isolated to a dedicated StreamingTail row so huge sessions no longer download or render in full.

Typing in the main LLM input is no longer laggy: drafts are localized to a leaf DraftedInputBar, the autosize machinery was rewritten around mirror-element measurement, and on Chromium/Electron CSS `field-sizing: content` owns the auto-grow so keystrokes cost zero synchronous layout reads.

The 1,510-line ChatInputBar was decomposed into memoized slot components (ModelControls, ChatModeBar, ProjectPicker, AgentInfoBar, AttachControl, InputStatusHints, AttachmentPreviews) with /-slash and @-mention machinery and per-mode model selection lifted into dedicated hooks; a regression test now guards that a draft change re-renders none of the chrome slots.

Per-tool tri-state permissions (on/ask/off) are now persisted on AgentPermissions and editable in the Permissions tab, forwarded to chat sessions and dev-loop/single-task automation runs; image chat mode rides the same harness generation session as video/3D, and the default org tool catalog gains generate_video plus quality/model knobs for image and 3D.

Dev loops now survive aura-os-server restarts: a per-run handle file is persisted so a restarted server can probe the harness sidecar, report `loop_state="detached"`, and have the AutomationBar re-adopt the run via the existing start/conflict path — rebuilding the forwarder and re-emitting loop_opened instead of leaving tasks advancing headless.

Chat now copes with messy tool transcripts: leaked Anthropic <invoke>/<function_calls> XML is hoisted into tool cards (with a server-side scrubber stripping markup from persisted text), the compaction `[tool_use ...]` dialect renders as proper Blocks, and unterminated [tool_result ...] markers are hoisted instead of leaking as a wall of N|-numbered lines.

Other chat quality fixes: the just-sent bubble no longer jumps on send (persisted-id ↔ clientId aliasing plus smarter input-bar measurement), and the terminal now remembers per-project command history across sessions and tabs via Arrow Up/Down over a localStorage-backed store.

All Explorer/Item call sites (Tasks, Plans, Files, ProjectList, Feed, Profile, Marketplace, Feedback, sidekick previews) were migrated onto app-owned ListItem and ListTree components with fixed slot order and symmetric insets, deleting the hashed-class CSS overrides that papered over zui row metrics.

The observability/status pipeline was rebuilt around a single generated snapshot at `infra/evals/reports/status/status.json`: probes got truthful, minimally-scoped permissions, regression-focused evals were added, a real history persistence step landed, and the bundled `interface/public/observability/status.json` second copy was retired so nightly/stable releases preserve a full snapshot from one source.

Server logs are quieter and more useful: chromiumoxide's invalid-CDP-message firehose is now logged once-with-preview instead of dumping multi-KB JSON at WARN on every Network event, and stale empty sessions are correctly retired against the unfiltered session list after migration 0014.

Interface test suites were unblocked on Node 25 by disabling the experimental Web Storage global and adding a jsdom Storage fallback, while ~20 suites were updated to track ListItem, paginated history, 3D model args, and redesigned billing/profile panels.

highlights: Per-tool tri-state permissions across chat and automation
